notes: *on* at t010 realizes the genitive case and rides with the article under rules 17 and 21, rather than being read as part of a phrasal *lay hold on*.
ἐνώπιον keeps the whole frame *in the sight of* including its trailing *of* and heads on *sight* under rules 71 and 95; no Greek article follows for rule 42's *of the* to attach to.
εἰς ἥν → *whereunto* is one `aligned` unit under rule 35, headed on the pronominal.
